phase_prompt.summary: The Angel stands as a silent guardian of data, holding the crystallized prayers of the righteous, preparing for upload.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic, eye-level cinematic shot of a mediator angel standing in a void. The figure is sculpted from matte black obsidian with subsurface gold light. It holds a radiant, multifaceted crystal prism in both hands, gazing down at it with a featureless glass face. Behind the figure, the air ripples with heat distortion where wings would be. The lighting is chiaroscuro, with the crystal serving as the primary light source, casting sharp reflections on the sleek black body. 8k resolution, octane render, photorealistic textures.
